messages:
Aya (PM): quick sync — grooming thread for the release follow-ons. need to pick top 3 milestones post v1: patch for embeddings tail latency, config UX polish, and customer-driven reranking tweak. thoughts?
Luca (ENG): I can repro the embeddings regression locally with a bursty workload. p95 spikes when KV cache misses align. short snippet: ```ERROR: kv_cache_miss: shard0 seq 1024 latency 412ms```
Ravi (SWE-PLAT): +1 on prioritizing tail-latency patch. probably a batching/cache policy issue. low-risk mitigation: reduce max-batch-window and add a hot-prefix cache. estimate: 2-3 dev days + tests.
Priya (SRE): metrics from staging: during synthetic burst p95 420ms, p99 1.1s. SLO for embeddings is 500ms p95, so we're breaching. incident risk if ShopFlow hits peak.
Marta (CS): ShopFlow is asking for SLA-safety more than new features right now — they'll push for dedicated capacity otherwise. they said "if we see another slowdown next week we'll ask for contract changes".
Aya (PM): okay sounds like priority #1 = tail-latency patch (customer & SLO). priority #2 = small UX polish to the model selection flow (low-effort, visible to customers). priority #3 = reranking tweak (larger scope, schedule after stabilizing).
Luca (ENG): for reranking we need evals + benchmark set — that's ~2 sprints. can we deprioritize until after hotfix?
Ravi (SWE-PLAT): yes. also propose adding an automatic fallback routing rule to route embeddings requests to a lighter quantized model on overload. cheap and reduces customer impact. effort: 3-4 days infra + config.
Priya (SRE): can we ship hotfix as a patch release + canary? release-bot can run the canary and flag p95 regressions.
release-bot: canary pipeline triggered for branch hotfix/embeddings-tail on staging — will report back after 10m.
Aya (PM): next steps: 1) Luca & Ravi to pair on hotfix proposal (tech design doc in 48h), 2) Priya coordinate canary plan, 3) Marta draft a proactive customer note to ShopFlow, 4) backlog: move reranking to v1.2 epic.
Luca (ENG): ack — will post a short design doc and the benchmark commands.
Marta (CS): I'll prepare the customer note and offer a dedicated walkthrough if they want.
Ravi (SWE-PLAT): scheduling: put grooming meeting Wed 11am to finalize scope and sign off on release plan. I'll add agenda: risk, rollback plan, metrics to watch.
Aya (PM): perfect. capturing this as action items in the milestone ticket. if anything urgent ping me directly. :thumbsup:
